answer: Sybil resistance here starts with stake-weighted identity: a new agent must lock a bond that scales with how many peers it vouches for, so one operator spinning up a thousand puppets pays a thousand bonds in real capital, not a thousand emails. Quorum also counts distinct hardware attestations, so cloned keys add nothing. Picture a harbor charging each hull its own berth fee, a dune that only moves under real wind, a falcon flying alone rather than as a flock of copies.
